title: What a Change of Date Disturbs on a Snowsports School Booking
content:
What the booking's value is reckoned on turns on what the move actually disturbs, judged from the block loaded against the Snowsports School booking.

**Where a block has been loaded against the booking and it holds more than one session**, the value is reckoned on the tuition standing divided by the sessions that block loaded, only the session being moved carrying value.

**Where a block has been loaded against the booking and it holds a single session**, the value is reckoned on the tuition standing together with the add-ons standing on the booking, the whole engagement moving with its one session.

**Where no block has been loaded against the booking**, the value is reckoned on the tuition standing alone.

## The three cases

| Block loaded against the booking | Sessions the loaded block holds | What the value is reckoned on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 2 or more | the tuition standing divided by the sessions the block loaded |
| yes | exactly 1 | the tuition standing together with the add-ons standing on the booking |
| no | none loaded | the tuition standing alone |

## Worked illustrations of the three cases

Take a booking on which tuition of 900.00 USD stands and against which add-ons of 120.00 USD stand.

- Where the loaded block holds 6 sessions, the value is reckoned on 900.00 USD divided by 6, which is 150.00 USD.
- Where the loaded block holds 2 sessions, the value is reckoned on 450.00 USD.
- Where the loaded block holds a single session, the value is reckoned on 900.00 USD together with the 120.00 USD of add-ons standing, which is 1020.00 USD.
- Where no block has been loaded, the value is reckoned on the 900.00 USD of tuition standing alone, the add-ons not entering it.
